sloka: एवमस्त्विति तं चाह वाक्यं देवः पितामहः ।मुक्तश्चेन्द्रजिता शक्रो गताश्च त्रिदिवं सुराः ।। ७.३०.१८ ॥
transliteration: evamastviti taṁ cāha vākyaṁ devaḥ pitāmahaḥ ।muktaścendrajitā śakro gatāśca tridivaṁ surāḥ ।। 7.30.18 ॥

translations.english: And thus, the god Brahma said to him, 'So be it,' whereupon Indra was released by Indrajit, and the gods returned to heaven.
